title: Lithium Americas Corp. Q1 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At March 31, 2026, cash was USD 758.5 million and restricted cash was USD 449.1 million. Thacker Pass targeted late-2027 mechanical completion; USD 1.1 billion of the USD 2.93 billion technical-report capex estimate had been spent, and fiscal-2026 project capex guidance was USD 1.3-1.6 billion.
summary: The SEC filing supports current Thacker Pass construction, capex, liquidity, ownership, DOE and GM funding, offtake, warrant, dilution, schedule, and pre-revenue risk analysis.
